audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 and 4 are marked 'Skill' while the prose for those exact rows says Reckless Swing 'chunks through your tank stats faster than your W heals' and calls level 6 'your worst window'. Row 6 is marked Olaf while whys[6] says the late game is 'only Skill if your team converts'.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Skill / Olaf x5 / Skill, matching the prose. Ragnarok at 6 deleting your entire CC identity cannot be a coin-flip row.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 to Olaf, row 6 to Skill, in both layers as one atomic group, ratings moved with them.

audit.why: Spikes are level 1-2 (your only window), level 6 Ragnarok, his first bruiser item, and your late fall-off. Correct ladder and correct owner for each.

audit.whatIsWrong: Olaf's slow is attributed to the wrong ability in four places — the page repeatedly says 'his W axe-slow' and 'his attack-speed slow'. Tough It Out (W) is a self-buff: it gives OLAF attack speed and a shield, and slows nothing. The slow and armour shred are Undertow (Q).
audit.why: This is the interaction the whole lane runs on. Undertow is a 1000-range axe on a 9s cooldown that reduces armour and move speed, and picking the axe back up refunds the cooldown entirely — that reset, not any W effect, is why you can never walk away. Reckless Swing is 325 range, 11/10/9/8/7s, true damage that also costs Olaf health and is refunded only on a kill.
audit.corrected: Undertow slows and shreds armour, and retrieving the axe resets its 9s cooldown. Tough It Out only buffs him. Reckless Swing is true damage through your shield on a 7-11s cooldown, and it costs him health if he does not kill you.
sources: champ-data/_kits/olaf.json (Q, W, E text and cooldowns)
